scope: Phase 9 independent review and uncertainty audit

criteria.requirement: Every review unit has a fresh passing record.
criteria.finding: 24 November 2026: npm run review -- check lists 237 records in 53 review units; the governing record of each unit (latest by date, then numeric suffix) is passed or passed_with_corrections and fresh. The 20 records written by the T11 re-reviews supersede the 16 the audit staled.

criteria.requirement: review -- check is clean: no invalid record and no stale record backing reviewed.
criteria.finding: 24 November 2026 at revision c2e1899: npm run review -- check exits 0 with 0 invalid records; npm run validate passes (563 canonical files), so no reviewed coverage row, component or object rests on a stale record. The 183 stale records back nothing and are history.

criteria.requirement: The informal-uncertainty inventory test passes with every family mandatory.
criteria.finding: 24 November 2026: all eight family fixtures exist and are required; every candidate note is inventoried as recorded, resolved or not_uncertainty, and every cited issue, review record and ruling resolves.

criteria.requirement: The checkpoint's carry-overs are dispositioned; each remaining bullet cites an issue id.
criteria.finding: 24 November 2026: of the eight bullets, two became issues (issue.sanity.inn_recovery_stay_limit, issue.guild.alchemist_availability_merged_tables) and stay listed citing them, four were corrected and re-reviewed in T11, and two were dismissed with reasons.

criteria.requirement: The extraction guide says uncertainty lives in review/ and that other notes may only point at it.
criteria.finding: 24 November 2026: "Uncertainty and evidence-backed resolutions" states that ledgers, the checkpoint, docs, corpus notes and review findings may point at issue ids but must not hold a doubt alone, and names the inventory test that enforces it.

criteria.requirement: Canonical graph edges and summaries are covered by fresh passing review evidence.
criteria.finding: 24 November 2026: every edge and summary in corpus/graph/ (17) sits in a reviewed section whose governing record is fresh, passing and examined it; the test's pending list is empty.
